title: EvidenceRef
description: A reference to a specific piece of evidence within the Evidara system. Used to link assertions, claims, or decisions back to their supporting source material.

document_id.description: ID of the document that contains the evidence.

section_id.description: ID of the specific section, if the evidence is localized.

citation_id.description: ID of a specific citation, if the evidence is a citation.

passage.description: Specific text passage that constitutes the evidence, if applicable.

confidence.description: Confidence score for AI-generated evidence references (0.0 to 1.0).
